Zoe Martinez: Hey hi! I'm Zoe (she/her) — starting today on Platform Eng. Previously at a tiny fintech. Super excited to be here :tada:
Zoe Martinez: I work remotely from Portland but plan to swing by the SF office next month. Also I have a corgi named Pixel who will probably be in my camera occasionally :dog:
Anna Gomez: Welcome Zoe!! I'm your onboarding buddy — sent a quick calendar to set up a 30m intro in a bit. Check your email or /calendar link: https://cal.com/anna/intro-30
Sam Hu: welcome!! Portland rep :raised_hands: If you need coworking recs hit me up. Also, favorite coffee shop?
Zoe Martinez: Thanks Anna + Sam — favorite coffee = oat latte. I will gladly accept any good bagel recs too (I have a bagel personal mission) :bagel:
Priya Rao: Oat latte gang. We have a little coffee station in SF (room B12) and a Nespresso in the kitchen. Also we keep a secret stash of cinnamon bagels in the pantry (don't tell finance) :shushing_face:
Juno Li: hi Zoe! quick heads up — if you're bringing Pixel to the office, stop by reception to get a guest pass and a sticker for the doggo. People love corgis here :heart_eyes:
Zoe Martinez: lol perfect. Will abide by sticker protocol. Also curious about desk plants — am I allowed to bring a jungle?
Maya Chen: Bring it. We lost a ficus to onboarding moves but we have a plant corner that will accept new members :seedling:
onboarding-bot: Reminder: Complete 1) HR forms, 2) Security training, 3) account provisioning. Links sent to Zoe via DM. Due in 3 days.
Anna Gomez: Also added you to #platform-oncall (read-only for now) and #platform-general. I'll DM the 90-day checklist. Quick fun question: snack preference? Zoe: gummy bears or dark chocolate.
Sam Hu: gummy bears forever. We have gummy jars in the snack room — you will be tempted. :eyes:
Priya Rao: Welcome again! If you want to shadow a playback of our infra deploy later this week ping me — super informal and a good way to meet people.
Zoe Martinez: love that, count me in. Very grateful for the warm welcome — see you all virtually and in SF soon :wave:
